description: This file defines the 'Engineering' class in the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library. It provides various engineering and mathematical functions, including conversions, Bessel functions, complex number operations, and constants. Many functions are marked as deprecated, directing users to more specific classes or methods. The class acts as a façade, delegating calls to specialized classes such as Complex, ComplexFunctions, ComplexOperations, and conversion classes.

classes.name: Engineering
classes.description: Provides various engineering and mathematical functions, constants, and conversion utilities. Acts as a facade delegating tasks to specific classes for complex operations, Bessel functions, complex numbers, conversions, and comparison functions.

methods.name: BESSELI
methods.description: Returns the modified Bessel function In(x), delegates to Engineering\BesselI::BESSELI.

methods.name: BESSELJ
methods.description: Returns the Bessel function J(x), delegates to Engineering\BesselJ::BESSELJ.

methods.name: BESSELK
methods.description: Returns the modified Bessel function Kn(x), delegates to Engineering\BesselK::BESSELK.

methods.name: BESSELY
methods.description: Returns the Bessel function Y(x), delegates to Engineering\BesselY::BESSELY.

methods.name: BINTODEC
methods.description: Converts a binary string to decimal, delegates to Engineering\\ConvertBinary::toDecimal.

methods.name: BINTOHEX
methods.description: Converts a binary string to hexadecimal, delegates to Engineering\\ConvertBinary::toHex.

methods.name: BINTOOCT
methods.description: Converts a binary string to octal, delegates to Engineering\\ConvertBinary::toOctal.

methods.name: DECTOBIN
methods.description: Converts decimal to binary, delegates to Engineering\\ConvertDecimal::toBinary.

methods.name: DECTOHEX
methods.description: Converts decimal to hexadecimal, delegates to Engineering\\ConvertDecimal::toHex.

methods.name: DECTOOCT
methods.description: Converts decimal to octal, delegates to Engineering\\ConvertDecimal::toOctal.

methods.name: HEXTOBIN
methods.description: Converts hexadecimal to binary, delegates to Engineering\\ConvertHex::toBinary.

methods.name: HEXTODEC
methods.description: Converts hexadecimal to decimal, delegates to Engineering\\ConvertHex::toDecimal.

methods.name: HEXTOOCT
methods.description: Converts hexadecimal to octal, delegates to Engineering\\ConvertHex::toOctal.

methods.name: OCTTOBIN
methods.description: Converts octal to binary, delegates to Engineering\\ConvertOctal::toBinary.

methods.name: OCTTODEC
methods.description: Converts octal to decimal, delegates to Engineering\\ConvertOctal::toDecimal.

methods.name: OCTTOHEX
methods.description: Converts octal to hexadecimal, delegates to Engineering\\ConvertOctal::toHex.

methods.name: COMPLEX
methods.description: Creates a complex number from real and imaginary parts, delegates to Engineering\Complex::COMPLEX.

methods.name: IMAGINARY
methods.description: Extracts the imaginary part of a complex number, delegates to Engineering\Complex::IMAGINARY.

methods.name: IMREAL
methods.description: Extracts the real part of a complex number, delegates to Engineering\Complex::IMREAL.

methods.name: IMABS
methods.description: Returns the modulus of a complex number, delegates to ComplexFunctions\IMABS.

methods.name: IMARGUMENT

methods.name: IMCONJUGATE

methods.name: IMCOS

methods.name: IMCOSH

methods.name: IMCOT
methods.description: Returns the cotangent of a complex number, delegates to ComplexFunctions\\IMCOT.

methods.name: IMCSC
methods.description: Returns the cosecant of a complex number, delegates to ComplexFunctions\\IMCSC.

methods.name: IMCSCH
methods.description: Returns the hyperbolic cosecant of a complex number, delegates to ComplexFunctions\\IMCSCH.

methods.name: IMSIN
methods.description: Returns the sine of a complex number, delegates to ComplexFunctions\\IMSIN.

methods.name: IMSINH
methods.description: Returns the hyperbolic sine of a complex number, delegates to ComplexFunctions\\IMSINH.

methods.name: IMSEC
methods.description: Returns the secant of a complex number, delegates to ComplexFunctions\\IMSEC.

methods.name: IMSECH
methods.description: Returns the hyperbolic secant of a complex number, delegates to ComplexFunctions\\IMSECH.

methods.name: IMTAN
methods.description: Returns the tangent of a complex number, delegates to ComplexFunctions\\IMTAN.

methods.name: IMSQRT

methods.name: IMLN
methods.description: Returns the natural logarithm of a complex number, delegates to ComplexFunctions\\IMLN.

methods.name: IMLOG10

methods.name: IMLOG2

methods.name: IMEXP

methods.name: IMSUM

methods.name: IMPRODUCT

methods.name: DELTA
methods.description: Tests equality of two values, delegates to Engineering\Compare::DELTA.

methods.name: GESTEP

methods.name: BITAND
methods.description: Performs bitwise AND, delegates to Engineering\BitWise::BITAND.

methods.name: BITOR
methods.description: Performs bitwise OR, delegates to Engineering\BitWise::BITOR.

methods.name: BITXOR

methods.name: BITLSHIFT

methods.name: BITRSHIFT
methods.description: Shifts number right by shift_amount bits, delegates to Engineering\\BitWise::BITRSHIFT.

methods.name: ERF
methods.description: Calculates the error function between bounds, delegates to Engineering\\Erf::ERF.

methods.name: ERFPRECISE
methods.description: Calculates the error function in a specified way, delegates to Engineering\\Erf::ERFPRECISE.

methods.name: ERFC
methods.description: Calculates the complementary error function, delegates to Engineering\\ErfC::ERFC.
